synonyms.title: synonyms
synonyms.text: offense resentment umbrage pique dudgeon huff mean an emotional response to or an emotional state resulting from a slight or indignity. offense implies hurt displeasure. resentment suggests lasting indignation or ill will. umbrage may suggest hurt pride, resentment, or suspicion of another's motives. pique applies to a transient feeling of wounded vanity. dudgeon suggests an angry fit of indignation. huff implies a peevish short-lived spell of anger usually at a petty cause.
examples: harbored a lifelong resentment of his brother
took umbrage at the offer of advice
